landmarks.shortDescription: The Victoria Theatre and Concert Hall is a performing arts centre in the Central Area of Singapore, situated along Empress Place.
landmarks.description: The Victoria Theatre and Concert Hall is a performing arts centre in the Central Area of Singapore, situated along Empress Place. It is a complex of two buildings and a clock tower joined together by a common corridor; the oldest part of the building was first built in 1862, and the complex was completed in 1909. The complex has undergone a number of renovations and refurbishment, mostly recently in 2010 when the complex was closed for a four-year renovation project. It reopened on 15 July 2014.

landmarks.description: Saint Andrew's Cathedral is an Anglican cathedral in Singapore. It is located near City Hall, Downtown Core, within the Central Area in Singapore's central business district. landmarks.name: Tanjong Pagar railway station
landmarks.shortDescription: Tanjong Pagar railway station, also known as Singapore railway station or Keppel Road railway station, is a former railway station located at 30 Keppel Road in Singapore.
landmarks.description: Tanjong Pagar railway station, also known as Singapore railway station or Keppel Road railway station, is a former railway station located at 30 Keppel Road in Singapore. The station was the southern terminus of the network operated by Keretapi Tanah Melayu (KTM), the main railway operator in Malaysia, until 30 June 2011 when the station ceased operations with relocation of the KTM station to Woodlands Train Checkpoint. The land on which the station and the KTM railway tracks stood was originally owned by KTM and over which Malaysia had partial sovereignty. This arrangement lasted until 30 June 2011, when rail service to Tanjong Pagar was ended and the land reverted to Singapore.

landmarks.description: This gateway with its sweeping Chinese roof is a replica of the original Nanyang University arch, which still stands across the Pan-Island Expressway at Jurong West Street 93. It was unveiled on 17 May 1995 in front of the former Nanyang University Library and Administration Building, because the original had ended up cut off from the campus. The original arch, the library building and a memorial in Yunnan Garden were gazetted together as a single national monument in 1998.

landmarks.description: Yunnan Garden was once the heart of Nanyang University and today sits within the campus of Nanyang Technological University. Its lawns, bamboo, streams and pavilions, together with the Nanyang University Memorial, form a heritage precinct of about nine hectares. The rejuvenated garden opened on 13 February 2020, with more than a thousand new trees and a waterfall joining it to Nanyang Lake.
